MRNA.why: News: The main Q3 driver was not earnings. In August, positive Phase 3 melanoma results for the personalized cancer vaccine developed with Merck sent the stock up about 177% in one day, its biggest gain on record. Q3 results on Nov 6 (an EPS profit against an expected loss, revenue up about 29%, 2026 revenue outlook raised) added more after the quarter ended.

PLTR.why: News: The Aug 3 Q2 report showed revenue up 93% y/y to $1.94B, and full-year revenue guidance was raised to about $8.15B. Management called it the largest guidance raise in company history. Coverage also flags a very high valuation (over 100x earnings).

VEEV.why: News: I found no clear news catalyst for the Q3 move. The next fiscal-quarter report comes in late November. Treat this as unexplained and check it manually.

MPC.why: News: Refiners led the S&P 500 in Q3 (MPC +55%, PSX +52%, VLO +49% by one count). War-related supply disruptions pushed diesel crack spreads (the margin between crude and refined fuel) to records, which led to windfall profits and larger buybacks.

PSX.why: News: Same driver as MPC and VLO: record diesel crack spreads from war-related supply disruptions lifted the whole refining group in Q3.

VLO.why: News: Same driver as MPC and PSX: record diesel crack spreads lifted the whole refining group in Q3.

WDAY.why: News: A rebound from a deep early-2026 selloff (down about 43% at one point on fears that AI would make some software obsolete). The rally came from AI-agent product momentum and investors positioning ahead of the late-August earnings report. Sources are thin, so verify this.

OKTA.why: News: The late-August fiscal-Q2 report beat estimates (EPS $1.05 vs $0.96), raised its full-year outlook and showed bookings up 14%. Cybersecurity stocks were also strong after CrowdStrike's results. The stock rose about 20-23% that week.

FICO.why: News: The Jul 30 report beat on profit, but guidance missed and there were signs of slowing mortgage volume. The stock fell about 17%, its worst day since 2020. A continuing pricing war in mortgage credit scores with VantageScore, plus regulatory scrutiny, drove further drops in September.

APP.why: News: The Aug 5 Q2 report missed on revenue ($1.92B vs $1.94B) and Q3 guidance came in light, even though EPS beat. After a strong run-up, the stock fell about 20%.

LII.why: News: Lennox cut its 2026 EPS guidance on weak residential HVAC demand and fell about 19%. One source; the date is unconfirmed.

NRG.why: News: Q2 adjusted EPS missed estimates because of higher interest and depreciation costs from the LS Power acquisition. The stock fell about 14.5% to a 52-week low, even though revenue beat and guidance was reaffirmed.

MGM.why: News: Las Vegas Strip weakness. By the Q3 report, Strip room rates and revenue per available room were down about 8%, and the company posted a rare quarterly loss. The weak Strip trend was visible through the summer.

KLAC.why: News: I found no single Q3 catalyst. Chip-equipment stocks fell on worries about export-license rules and cooling memory spending, after KLAC had more than doubled in Q2. Treat this as a likely sector/valuation pullback and verify it.
